t: You're looking at the tomb of Emmeline Pankhurst, who organised the British suffragette movement. Women won the vote in Great Britain and Ireland in 1918, and her work is recognised as a crucial part of that. She was widely criticised for her militant tactics, and historians still disagree about how effective they were. In 1999 Time named her one of the hundred most important people of the twentieth century. The monument was made by Julian Phelps Allan, an English sculptor who also served in both world wars.
